data.name: FileNotAddedModuleNameTaken
data.value: '{0}' is not in the project: the project has a module named {1} already, and a module name is unique in a project.

data.name: ProjectFileNotWritten
data.value: The files changed, and the project file could not be written: {0} The project is as it was.

data.name: ProjectFileNotReloaded
data.value: The project file changed, and could not be read: {0} The workspace is as it was.

data.name: ProjectReloadedProgramRunning
data.value: The project file changed while a program runs: the files it lists are loaded, and the program keeps the modules it started with. A module the project gained is part of the project once the program ends, and a program that waits is not resumed while the project lists it.

data.name: SyncCancelled
data.value: it was not loaded before the loading was stopped

data.name: PullDeclinedWhileADialogIsOpen
data.value: The program waits for a dialog to be answered: its diagnostics are given once the dialog is closed.

data.name: CircularProjectReference
data.value: The project {0} is on a circular reference of projects: {1}. Remove one of the references on the path.

data.name: ProjectFileFormatOlder
data.value: The project file is in the format {0}, older than this platform's {1}: it is written in the format {1} when it is next saved.

data.name: ProjectFileFormatNewerMinor
data.value: The project file is in the format {0}, newer than this platform's {1}: what this platform doesn't know of it is kept as it is.

data.name: ProjectFileFormatNewerMajor
data.value: The project file is in the format {0}, a major version newer than this platform's {1}: it was read as the format {1}, and what it holds may not all have been read.

data.name: ProjectFileFormatUnparseable
data.value: The project file says its format is '{0}', which is no format's version: it was read as the format {1}.
